headline: Proposed Instruction 742 policy on extended learning opportunities, plus school and special education presentations.
summary: The committee will consider an updated policy on extended learning opportunities, such as internships and independent study. Other items are presentations on schools, special education, and career pathways, plus a math curriculum update.

Per the Strategic Plan, our Mission objective is to provide a transformational learning experience and ensure that every MSD learner has high quality 
postsecondary options to attain a technical certificate, gainful employment, and/or a two-year or four-year degree. 
 
AGENDA 
 
MANCHESTER SCHOOL DISTRICT SAU #37 
COMMITTEE ON TEACHING AND LEARNING 
 
October 27, 2026 6:00 p.m. 
Committee Members Parr, Turner, Stewart, Georges, & Smith Aldermanic Chambers 
Student Representatives:  Achok Lual & Anthony Gammella (MHS) City Hall (3rd Floor) 
 
 
1. Chair Parr calls the meeting to order. 
 
2. The Clerk calls the roll. 
 
3. Public Forum  
 
a. Chair Parr advises that the purpose of the public forum is to give the residents of Manchester 
the opportunity to address the board on items of concerns affecting the community; each 
person will be given only one opportunity to speak; comments shall be limited to three minutes 
to allow all participants the opportunity to speak and any comments must be directed to the 
Chair. Speakers may offer comments on school operations and programs that concern them. 
 
b. Chair Parr advises that if there was no one else present wishing to speak, a motion would be in 
order to take all comments under advisement and further to receive and file any written 
documentation presented.  
 
 
4. Approval of Minutes from the September 22, 2026, Teaching and Learning Committee Meeting 
 Ladies and Gentlemen, what is your pleasure?
